label: November 23–29, 2026
intro: Loy Krathong on Tuesday night, the last Vijit fireworks, and a closing weekend for the Theatre Festival.

activities.title: Loy Krathong at Benjakitti or Lumpini Park
activities.location: Benjakitti Park (Queen Sirikit MRT) or Lumpini Park (Silom/Lumpini MRT)
activities.why: He gets to float his own krathong on a calm lake: candles, lights and a big festival without the riverside crush.
activities.tip: Make a banana-leaf or bread-free krathong together that afternoon (foam and sky lanterns are banned). One krathong per family. Take the MRT, not a taxi.

activities.title: Bambini Villa Loy Krathong Festival (daytime)
activities.why: Daytime krathong-making and festival fun for little kids, a great warm-up before the evening float.
activities.tip: Listed via BKK Kids; confirm booking.

activities.title: Vijit Chao Phraya — final fireworks night
activities.why: Last scheduled fireworks of the festival. Light shows continue nightly to Dec 13.
activities.tip: Arrive by 7pm. A river ferry ride there is half the fun.

activities.title: Bangkok Theatre Festival — closing weekend family shows
activities.why: Last chance for kids' stage shows this year.
activities.tip: Book popular children's shows early; they sell out on the final weekend.

activities.title: Grow Forest School Family Day
activities.why: Muddy hands, building with sticks and outdoor play. Building & making in nature.
activities.tip: Listed via BKK Kids. Bring bug spray and a change of clothes.

activities.title: Arcadia Academy — 'Thai Scents, Thai Styles, Little Smiles' kids' session
activities.why: Hands-on Thai crafts and scents morning, a little making workshop.
activities.tip: Confirm age range with Arcadia before booking.

activities.title: EJAN FAIR x Moon Rim Lake (Loy Krathong fair)
activities.why: Lakeside fair with food, live music and krathong floating, if you're up north of the city.
activities.tip: Busy on Loy Krathong night itself; go Monday the 23rd for a calmer visit.
